repeat.title: Repeat announcement
repeat.hint: Repeats the balance announcement, with a short pause, until you press Stop.
repeat.help: Tap Stop to end the loop.

reset.description: Sets the balance, card and history back to their initial state.
reset.confirmMessage: The balance, card and history will be restored to their initial state.

about.title: About
about.text: A visualization and manifestation tool. Fictional balance and card, with no value and no link to any bank.
